personality_limits.title: Limits of adaptation
personality_limits.auto_body: On its own the assistant may shift its way of speaking at most to this intensity, and only to the moods you allow. This is the range of automatic adaptation.
personality_limits.auto_off: Automatic adaptation is off: manual mode or range 0.
personality_limits.owner_body: When you ask for a mood yourself («more serious», or a button below), it may go beyond that range, up to {max}. It is still limited to the moods you allow, never above {max}, and it lasts this session only.
personality_limits.moods_body: Both limits apply only to these moods. A mood that is not allowed is refused, whoever asks.
personality_limits.never_body: Facts, accuracy, privacy, approvals, tools, budgets and stopping. A mood is simulated: a way of speaking, not a feeling.
personality_limits.ch_text: Written chat: the style is part of the instructions the assistant receives.
personality_limits.ch_realtime: Voice conversations (realtime): the style is sent as wording instructions. It changes how the assistant words things, not how the voice sounds.
personality_limits.ch_voice: Voice: no speech provider can change tone per turn, so the voice itself is not modulated.
personality_limits.ch_avatar: Avatar: not connected to the app yet; there is no lip sync.
personality_limits.delivery_title: When a voice engine picks up a change
personality_limits.delivery_connect_only: only when a call starts (a change applies to the next call)
personality_limits.stop_note: After STOP nothing from the earlier turn is applied; the style is read again for the next one.
